parameters.name: DagId
parameters.description: The ID of the task flow. You can call the [ListTaskFlowInstance](~~424689~~) operation to query the task flow ID.

parameters.name: NewOwnerId
parameters.description: The user ID of the new owner. You can call the [GetUser](~~147098~~) or [ListUsers](~~141938~~) operation to query the user ID.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The ID of the tenant.

>  To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~).
